info.title: How to Be Understood
info.subtitle: Six-second habits that help someone with hearing loss follow along

rows.title: Get their attention
rows.desc: Say their name and wait for eye contact

rows.title: Face the light
rows.desc: Let them see your lips and expressions

rows.title: Slow down, don't shout
rows.desc: A natural pace is clearer than volume

rows.title: Rephrase, don't repeat
rows.desc: Swap in new words when a line misses

rows.title: Quiet the room
rows.desc: Lower the TV and pick calmer spots
